# Origin and scope

共用方法由既有工作經驗整理而成；來源名稱只用來追溯，使用時不需要取得來源產品。

Generalized and rewritten from MIT-licensed engineering methods in [sunpochin/jia-jian-log at fefc821045cc92df25101ce1554fb6c80e4e0093](https://github.com/sunpochin/jia-jian-log/tree/fefc821045cc92df25101ce1554fb6c80e4e0093), copyright (c) 2026 sunpochin. The original MIT notice is retained in LICENSE. Source mappings are recorded in provenance.json at the collection root.

Experience adapting these methods in Dance Stamp informed separation of methods, project policy and personal preferences. This collection is written from the MIT source methods; it does not copy application code or later product-specific documentation derivatives and does not change either product's license.

No application, patient/user data, private media, database migrations, deployment settings, internal incident transcripts, credentials or third-party design catalogs are included. This repository has independent history and no affiliation with or endorsement by an agent vendor or hosting provider.
